## Overview
Ajay Autade is a DevOps & Cloud Engineer specializing in AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes container orchestration, automated zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform & Ansible), DevSecOps, and MLOps deployment pipelines. He partners with technology teams and companies worldwide to build resilient, self-healing, and scalable infrastructure.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Cloud Providers:** Amazon Web Services (AWS) — EC2, EKS, ECR, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route53; Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- **Containerization & Orchestration:** Docker (multi-stage builds, 73% image compression), Kubernetes (EKS, Kind, Minikube), Helm package manager, Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA), Ingress controllers.
- **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Terraform (reusable modules, state locking with S3/DynamoDB, zero-drift), Ansible (configuration management & provisioning).
- **CI/CD & GitOps:** GitHub Actions, Jenkins (Declarative pipelines), ArgoCD (GitOps continuous delivery, automated sync), SonarQube (static code analysis), Trivy (container vulnerability scanning).
- **Observability & Monitoring:** Prometheus (PromQL metrics collection & alerting), Grafana (interactive operational dashboards), AWS CloudWatch.
- **MLOps & AI Infrastructure:** End-to-end ML model deployment pipelines, inference tracking, GPU infrastructure configuration, automated model serving.
- **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Bash/Shell scripting, YAML, Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine).

## Notable Engineering Projects
1. **MLOps Sentiment Analyzer on AWS EKS:**
   - Zero-touch GitOps deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.
   - Slashed code-to-production deployment turnaround from 45 minutes to ~8 minutes.
   - Multi-stage Docker optimization reducing image footprint by 73% (3 GB down to 800 MB).
   - Kubernetes HPA automated scaling (2 to 10 pods) and 9 real-time inference telemetry metrics tracked via Prometheus and Grafana.

2. **MoviesMonkey Cloud-Native Platform on AWS EKS:**
   - Dual-pipeline CI/CD architecture featuring automated Trivy container vulnerability scanning.
   - ArgoCD automated state synchronization every 3 minutes for rolling zero-downtime updates.
   - 5-service full-stack observability stack with custom PromQL alert rules.

3. **Production End-to-End GitOps Infrastructure:**
   - Automated deployment utilizing Kind, Helm, AWS ECR, Terraform, and OIDC IAM federation.
